name: Haggith
title: David's wife and Adonijah's mother
summary: Haggith was one of King David's wives and the mother of Adonijah, who was David's fourth son. She is best known through her son Adonijah's attempt to seize the throne from Solomon after David's death.

keyEvents.title: Wife of King David
keyEvents.description: Haggith became one of David's wives while he was king in Hebron and bore him a son named Adonijah.

keyEvents.title: Mother of Adonijah
keyEvents.description: Haggith gave birth to Adonijah, who became David's fourth son, born in Hebron.

keyEvents.title: Adonijah's rebellion and claim to the throne
keyEvents.description: Adonijah, the son of Haggith, attempted to seize the kingdom from Solomon after David's death, which led to his downfall.
